note: Every entry is PROPOSED. A waiver takes effect only when a named owner accepts it; none has been named, so none is in effect.

entries.text: Catalogue schema PK_SIGNAL_CATALOGUE/1 has no kind for event records (finding F-03). Extending the schema is an owner decision.
Pure-Python Ed25519 is not constant-time and verifies at ~26 ms (evidence/perf_baseline.json). Production requires a native, constant-time provider.

No AEAD in the stdlib; EnvelopeGuard refuses sensitive persistence without a KMS provider. Replay log, WAL and audit ledger are therefore plaintext files holding identifiers (no secrets) until a provider is wired.
Regression-gate thresholds (p95 x1.5, p99 x2.0) are proposals, not approved budgets.
MASTER.md cannot be recovered from this archive. Either the owner supplies it, or README/CHANGELOG/AUDIT_REPORT/MISSING_COMPONENTS are corrected; tools/doc_check.py fails until one happens.
